# Red packets

A complete set of interfaces from composing to claiming. Reuse shared money, state, and visual contracts while the host supplies service results.

## Choose by task

| Stage | Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compose | [RedPacketComposer](/en/components/red-packet-composer) | Kind, amount, count, recipient, and greeting |
| Message | [RedPacketCard](/en/components/red-packet-card) | Chat entry and claim status, retaining the existing timeline layout |
| Open | [RedPacketOpenSheet](/en/components/red-packet-open-sheet) | Envelope, open action, loading, retry, and details |
| Inspect | [RedPacketDetail](/en/components/red-packet-detail) | Sender, own amount, claims, and refund notice |

## Compose and confirm payment

Group chats offer lucky, normal, or exclusive kinds. Direct chats receive only normal, without redundant kind or count fields. Keep amount and count together and show the total before the main action. The host composes [PaymentConfirmation](/en/components/payment-confirmation) when needed instead of introducing another confirmation page. Cancel and failure retain inputs. Demo submissions only change local UI and never transfer funds.

## Claim and recover

Ready shows the open action; opening retains the envelope and blocks duplicates; failure shows an inline error with retry. Finished, expired, refunded, and ineligible each explain their outcome. Details appear only when permitted by the host; avoid reducing every outcome to a disabled button.

## Details hierarchy

The red arch uses the shared 72px header size, followed by sender, greeting, own amount, and deposit notice. Summaries and claim rows form a separate section. Display only host-provided amounts, eligibility, and best-luck markers. Never infer private amounts or present an unresolved operation as successful.

## Desktop and mobile

Compose and details follow container width with a readable content limit; desktop can host them in a page or side panel. Mobile uses a complete page, and long kind labels wrap at 320px. The claim dialog retains its red envelope and gold primary action; narrow and short screens can reach close and details. No essential action depends on hover or gestures.

## States and accessibility

Check initial, direct, group, exclusive, unavailable, busy, locked, invalid input, and failed claim states. IME confirmation cannot submit; Tab reaches actions, Enter respects disabled states, and errors are announced. Red decoration carries no status meaning. Inspect both documentation themes for contrast.
